description.zh: 广岛和平纪念公园见证了二战的历史教训；乘船15分钟可达的宫岛岛上，严岛神社的朱红大鸟居矗立于海中，是日本三景之一。
description.en: Hiroshima Peace Memorial Park bears witness to the lessons of WWII. A 15-minute ferry brings you to Miyajima island, where Itsukushima Shrine's vermilion torii gate rises from the sea — one of Japan's Three Views.

location.zh: 广岛县广岛市及廿日市市

zh: 广岛和平纪念馆：原爆穹顶UNESCO遗产
宫岛严岛神社海中大鸟居
退潮可步行至鸟居脚下近距离观看
en: Hiroshima Peace Memorial and A-Bomb Dome UNESCO site
Itsukushima Shrine's torii gate rising from the sea
At low tide you can walk right up to the gate

admission.zh: 和平纪念馆200日元，宫岛神社免费

tips.zh: 出发前查看宫岛潮汐表，退潮时段才能走到鸟居旁边。牡蛎和枫叶馒头是当地必尝美食。
tips.en: Check tide tables before going — only at low tide can you approach the torii on foot. Try the local oysters and momiji manju (maple-leaf cakes).
